findings.title: Store imported by a relative src path instead of @norn/store
findings.detail:
`import { loadWorkflows, workflowsDir } from "../../packages/store/src/index.ts"`, while the root package.json declares @norn/store and the same file imports @norn/core by name. The code rules ask for `@norn/<pkg>` across packages.
Axis: standards
Suggestion: Import from "@norn/store".
